name: How can I improve lighting in a dark hallway?

mainEntity.name: How can I improve lighting in a dark hallway?

acceptedAnswer.text: Improving lighting in a dark hallway can be achieved through a combination of artificial and natural light strategies. Incorporate recessed lighting, wall sconces, or a statement pendant light to provide adequate illumination. Adding mirrors can reflect existing light and brighten the space. For deeper hallways, consider installing a solar tube or transom windows to bring in natural light, especially if exterior walls are nearby. We help clients plan lighting schemes to transform dark spaces effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: To brighten a dark hallway, use recessed lights, sconces, or pendant lights, and strategically place mirrors. Solar tubes or transom windows can also introduce natural light.
